svg.desc: Every frame of every clip: meshes moved by a transform and meshes of their own
svg.text: Figure 2 · Every frame of every clip
4 clips, 50 frames. In each frame a mesh is either a standing mesh moved by a fitted transform (10,168 in all, 594 of them by a rigid match) or a mesh of its own where
the shape changes, such as a hose or a stretching limb (305).
Standing mesh moved by a transform (light)
Mesh of its own for that frame (solid)
Bar height: meshes shown in the frame (up to 226).

Generated by tools/figures/assets3d_readme.py from the mesh table in the geometry file. CL-05 concept geometry for review, not a design: posed by concept kinematics, with no dynamics, balance or load model.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout)
